title: Mauna Lani Point #F102 | KEY.co
description_expanded: With exclusive access to the Mauna Lani Beach Club and preferred rates at the resort’s championship golf courses, this is an exceptional escape for golf lovers and beachgoers alike. Enjoy a complimentary PXG club fitting with a local specialist, take a dip in the recently refreshed pool and hot tub, or unwind in the sauna after a day of exploring the island. Thoughtful touches like a spa-style soaking tub, dual shower heads, and a work-from-home setup in the primary suite elevate the experience even further. Whether you're chasing adventure or simply seeking a tranquil coastal haven, Mauna Lani Point #F102 delivers the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and island charm. Perfectly positioned along the oceanfront fairways of the legendary Mauna Lani Golf Course, Mauna Lani Point #F102 is a serene ground-floor retreat offering uninterrupted views of the Pacific and lush green landscapes. This beautifully appointed two-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath residence blends island elegance with modern comfort, featuring an open-concept living area, granite countertops, and warm tropical décor. The private lanai is a highlight, offering a peaceful place to sip morning coffee or watch the sun dip below the horizon.
